_comment: TinyPond rules. 9 total. Day/night oscillation drives plant growth; fish drift + eat. Sunlight broadcast via contact between pond_clock and plants (radius 1000). All formulas use Python-style ternary.

rules._comment: Time advances every tick. Cycle = 500 ticks per pond-day (50s at tick_seconds=0.1). Offset 0.25 so the game STARTS AT NOON — plants grow immediately rather than waiting through 12s of dawn.
Sunlight = max(0, sin(time_of_day * 2*pi)). Smooth ramp up to 1 at midday, 0 at midnight. Stored on pond_clock; plants read via contact rule.
Pond_clock broadcasts sunlight to all creatures via contact (radius 1000 = entire pond). Used by night-slowdown rule below to read 'is it night?'.
All plants (seed + mature) receive sunlight broadcast from pond_clock. Seeds use it to gate growth; mature plants use it to gate seeding. Single rule keeps both phases consistent.
Plant grows when its sunlight state > 0.3. Growth amount = grow_rate (5) when sunlit, 0 otherwise. Python-style ternary required (Godot Expression doesn't parse C-style).
Seed → mature when growth crosses 100. Transform preserves position; new entity gains 'edible' tag from def.
Mature plants slowly seed nearby (anytime — even at night). The new seeds won't GROW until sunlight returns; that gate is in plant_seed_grows_in_sun. Interval 60 + chance 0.05.
Fish drift in random walk. Velocity changes ~once per 10 ticks (chance 0.4 per 4-tick interval). x and y are independent randf-derived values in [-30, 30] px/sec.

Creature eats mature plant — works day OR night, always drops a seed. The seed exists but won't GROW until sunlight returns (gated by plant_seed_grows_in_sun). Night is a 'dormant pond' phase: seeds wait for sun to mature. Honest ecosystem: planting happens anytime, growth waits for sun.

Hunger rises faster when moving (energy spent) and slower when still. Formula = base 0.5 + speed_bonus where speed_bonus scales with velocity magnitude. Stationary fish gain ~0.5/tick; full-speed fish ~2.5/tick. Encourages tactical play: don't sprint everywhere.
Mark hungry fish so asset-designer can render them visually distinct. No remove rule — once hungry, stays tagged. Acceptable for v1.

Night slowdown — when self.state.time_of_day is in night phase (>0.5), halve velocity. Day/night becomes mechanically visible: night = sluggish, day = fast. Combined with plants not growing at night, the player feels real timing pressure.

Pond bounds — clamp creatures + plants every tick. Plants need clamping because plant_seeding and eat-drops-seed spawn at parent ±50px; plants near the edge can overshoot. tags_any matches if entity has EITHER tag.
WASD input rules — target='actor' resolves to entity tagged 'player' (world.gd actor_tag). Velocity in pixels/sec; engine integrates motion per-frame.
When no movement key is held, world.gd queues a 'stop' input — set velocity to zero. Without this, fish drifts forever after each keypress.
